name: agents-can-communicate
desc: Let your AI coding sessions talk to each other. Coordinate parallel work, exchange reviews, and hand off unfinished work between Claude Code, Codex, and other supported clients. Local-first. Independent sessions.

name: cindy
desc: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。

name: cf-mailroom
desc: Self-hosted email for humans and AI agents, on Cloudflare

name: amux
desc: Open-source control plane for AI coding agents. Run an AI engineering team: parallel Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini workers with a shared board, atomic tasks, schedules, loops, origin-stamped messaging, model switching, and self-healing recovery. One dashboard, or your phone. MIT, single Rust binary.

name: aidevops
desc: Vibe-Coding is easy. DevOps is hard. OpenCode & Git token-efficient AI agent automation for your app, business, and personal development. Opinionated tools, services, CLI & API stack for speed, security, and 24/7 results. Open-source first. SOTA everything. The best AI harness for GitHub & teamwork.

name: gai
desc: A lightweight AI agent and skill workflow framework built with Godot.

name: BossConsole
desc: Open-source, multi-platform harness for AI agents - a native, multi-threaded operator's console (JVM, not Electron) to run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode with a real browser, terminal, editor, secrets & 100+ MCP tools. Built for enterprises, science & research.

name: pipelock
desc: Open-source AI agent firewall for MCP security and agent egress. Scans mediated HTTP, MCP, A2A, and WebSocket traffic for exfiltration, SSRF, and prompt injection, and emits mediator-signed action receipts: verifiable audit evidence from outside the agent.

name: Peekaboo
desc: Peekaboo is a macOS CLI & optional MCP server that enables AI agents to capture screenshots of applications, or the entire system, with optional visual question answering through local or remote AI models.

name: athas
desc: A lightweight, cross-platform code editor, built with Tauri (Rust and React) with Git support, AI agents, vim keybindings.
